svg.title: Whole-body delivery model
svg.desc: Systemic distribution, barrier transport and expression, explicit RNA product states, and a complementary tissue coverage model. Central modeling data informs RNA product composition. Outputs distinguish intended-product retention, unwanted-edit burden, and tissue coverage. Schematic only; no measured data are depicted.
svg.metadata: Scientific source: wiki/pages/software.html. AI-assisted art direction; original Python vector construction. Reproduce with scripts/draw_delivery_overview.py. Created 2026-10-16. License: CC BY 4.0, as in the repository.
